title: Cargo and convoy clearance
summary: Vehicle-profile creation and editing, full and partial clearance permits, cargo review, existing-submission retrieval, and a two-vehicle convoy through review.

flows.name: Create vehicle profile
flows.outcome: Completed: SBA1234G saved with synthetic contact details after required-field validation.

flows.name: Edit vehicle profile
flows.outcome: Completed: email updated and the new value carried into the cargo submission form.

flows.name: Cargo with full clearance
flows.outcome: Synthetic permit IG2BB990001 saved and displayed in review.

flows.name: Cargo with partial clearance
flows.outcome: Synthetic permit IG2BB990002 with quantity 10 saved alongside the full-clearance permit and displayed in review.

flows.name: Cargo submission
flows.outcome: Review and Submit control reached. No declaration was sent and no application reference was generated.

flows.name: Manage existing submission
flows.outcome: ARN and vehicle-number retrieval form opened. A matching submitted reference is needed to continue.

flows.name: Two-vehicle convoy
flows.outcome: Two synthetic vehicles, contact details and permit IG2BB990003 accepted through review. No convoy declaration was sent.

flows.name: Convoy low value goods
flows.outcome: YES selected. Attempting Next without a permit showed Please fill in the field above; saving a permit allowed review.

flows.name: Language
flows.outcome: Cargo language selector opened. English retained.

notes: The convoy page displays a 15-vehicle limit and the cargo permit page displays a 100-permit limit; these maxima were not exercised.
Native screens belong to the staging app. In-app web endpoints may use a different environment. Only draft form navigation was performed; real-world declarations were not submitted.

No barcode fixture, existing ARN or physical cargo-checkpoint equipment was supplied. Permit scanning, amendment of a submitted declaration and physical clearance remain outside the completed walkthrough.
